rules.name: PowerShell Suspicious Execution
rules.description: Detect encoded PowerShell, -bypass, hidden window, and download cradle patterns
rules.aql_query: SELECT * FROM events WHERE (PAYLOAD LIKE '%-enc%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%base64%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%eval%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%system(%') AND (PROCESS_NAME IN ('powershell.exe', 'cmd.exe', 'bash', 'sh')) LAST 15 MINUTES
